title: Fix Flow Control line color and auto-zoom to last day on all charts

requirements.summary: Fix the 'Flow control (Pa)' line color in FanVoltageFlowControlChart to render black in light mode and white in dark mode (currently inverted).
acceptanceCriteria: In light mode, the 'Flow control (Pa)' line in FanVoltageFlowControlChart is visually black.
In dark mode, the 'Flow control (Pa)' line in FanVoltageFlowControlChart is visually white.
No other chart line colors are affected.

file_operations.description: Correct the stroke color for the 'Flow control (Pa)' Line component by swapping the light/dark mode color values. Change from 'hsl(var(--background))' for light and 'hsl(var(--foreground))' for dark to the opposite: use 'hsl(var(--foreground))' in light mode (renders as black/dark text color) and 'hsl(var(--background))' in dark mode (renders as white/light background color). Ensure no other line colors in this chart are modified.

requirements.summary: On initial page load, all charts must automatically zoom into the last day of available data while allowing manual zoom out to the full dataset.
acceptanceCriteria: When the page loads, every chart's visible time window is automatically set to the last 24 hours (last day) of available data.
The Brush and/or zoom state is initialized to the last day range on mount.
Users can manually drag or reset the Brush/zoom to view earlier data or the full dataset.
This auto-zoom behavior applies to all chart components: TemperatureChart, CO2Chart, CoolingHeatingVentilationChart, FanVoltageFlowControlChart, and TSICSensorChart.

file_operations.description: Add logic to automatically initialize the time window (zoom state) to the last day (24 hours) of available data on component mount. After data loads, compute the last data point's index and set the initial window to span from (lastIndex - pointsInOneDay) to lastIndex. Ensure the Brush component reflects this initial range. Users must still be able to manually drag the Brush or reset zoom to view the full dataset.
